maddeler.e:
نتصهين (form IIq)
# نَتَصَهْيَنُ (nataṣahyanu) /na.ta.sˤah.ja.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
# نَتَصَهْيَنَ (nataṣahyana) /na.ta.sˤah.ja.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
# نَتَصَهْيَنْ (nataṣahyan) /na.ta.sˤah.jan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
